typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Sale_Type_CD as string,
		Fyear_ID as string,
		FDay_ID as string,
		BusinessDay_Dt as string,
		BusinessUnit_CD as string,
		Loc_ID as string,
		ItemSku_Num as string,
		Customer_Account_ID as string,
		Currency as string,
		Sales as string,
		Cost as string,
		Program_USD_AMT as string,
		Comments as string,
		Adjustment_Type_CD as string,
		Order_id as string,
		Sub_Order_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> MainSalesAdjustments
MainSalesAdjustments derive(Source = 'Main_Sales_Adjustments',
		Loc_ID = trim(Loc_ID),
		Order_id = trim(Order_id),
		Sale_Type_CD = trim(Sale_Type_CD),
		Adjustment_Type_CD = trim(Adjustment_Type_CD),
		ItemSku_Num = trim(ItemSku_Num),
		Comments = trim(Comments),
		Sub_Order_ID = trim(Sub_Order_ID),
		FDay_ID = trim(FDay_ID),
		Cost = trim(Cost),
		Program_USD_AMT = trim(Program_USD_AMT),
		BusinessUnit_CD = trim(BusinessUnit_CD),
		Sales = trim(Sales),
		BusinessDay_Dt = trim(BusinessDay_Dt),
		Customer_Account_ID = trim(Customer_Account_ID),
		Currency = trim(Currency),
		Fyear_ID = trim(Fyear_ID)) ~> Addcolumns
Addcolumns derive(Comments = toString(Comments),
		Source = toString(Source)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Loc_ID as integer,
		Order_ID as string,
		Sale_Type_CD as integer,
		Adjustment_Type_Cd as string,
		ItemSku_Num as integer,
		Comments as string,
		Sub_Order_ID as integer,
		FDay_ID as integer,
		Cost as integer,
		Source as string,
		Program_USD_AMT as integer,
		Sales as integer,
		BusinessUnit_CD as string,
		BusinessDay_Dt as integer,
		Customer_Account_ID as integer,
		Currency as string,
		Fyear_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Loc_ID,
		Order_ID = Order_id,
		Sale_Type_CD,
		Adjustment_Type_Cd = Adjustment_Type_CD,
		ItemSku_Num,
		Comments,
		Sub_Order_ID,
		FDay_ID,
		Cost,
		Source,
		Program_USD_AMT,
		Sales,
		BusinessUnit_CD,
		BusinessDay_Dt,
		Customer_Account_ID,
		Currency,
		Fyear_ID)) ~> FinanceOtherAdjSalesType
